'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Giannetti LS K'lor'slug (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|K'lor'slug (V) (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour)|OVS2-12-K_lor_slug-remaster.webp|label=K'lor'slug (V)}}

* '''Username:''' Jigga
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
